notes: Reach 35 m (OM2, 500 MHz·km) and 100 m (OM3, 2000 MHz·km) per Recommended Operating Conditions; Features states up to 100 m at 10 G/channel on OM3. Link budget footnote allocates 3.5 dB/km attenuation, 1.5 dB connector loss, 0.3 dB modal noise penalty—not module insertion loss. Several limits marked TBD or Informative (e.g. Input Optical Power Sensitivity OMA -9.8 dBm max, Output OMA -3 dBm min). Nominal wavelength 850 nm in Description; center wavelength 840–860 nm in optical tables. AFBR-79Q5Z is 5G Infiniband variant. Case temperature typ 40°C in spec tables.
